title: Ruleset primitive (docs/rulesets.md#rules-data)
description: One SRD rule kept with its ruleset at rulesets/<ruleset>/rules/<type>/<id>.json. Every primitive is an SRD rule, reproduced unmodified, so it has no summary, meta, tags, description, or image. `stats` is validated by the ruleset's schema for the type, the same schema an extension's stats use.

type.description: The rules type, listed under `rules` in the ruleset's ruleset.json, such as "condition".

id.description: The slug of the name, equal to the file name. Unique across the type's primitives, groups, and extensions.

name.description: The SRD name exactly. Unique across the type's primitives, groups, and extensions, ignoring case.

stats.description: Rules data, validated by the ruleset's schema for the type.
